## Goal

State the experiment, editorial, lesson, or automation outcome and explicit non-goals.

## Change

Name affected code, cases, evidence, lessons, and branch routing.

## Verification

List exact targeted tests, the full test suite, and lesson-integrity checks.

## Detector and semantic impact

State whether meaning, owner-final prose, cache identities, task IDs, paid calls, or detector evidence changed.

## Lesson closeout

List each substantive finding and its disposition, evidence pointer, and promoted index update when applicable.

- [ ] Final diff reviewed
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Lesson closeout/audit passes
- [ ] No credential or duplicate-call risk introduced
